preview: For the patient, we will perform a hepato-biliary surgery on the uterus. The liver should be of normal size, normal parasympathetic echo, the gallus and midi stent should be normal, the proximal part of the CBD should be normal, the midi distal part should be shadow, the visual part of the pancreas should be normal, and the spleen should be normal. We will now perform the surgery.
